name: Feature build
description: Any feature or fix build launched headless (axHub vps.build_start, the console's Build manager, the orchestrator, deploy/claude-headless.sh). The launcher books it on a named agent before it starts; the build's own brief says what to build.
author: AmberX AXF

inputs.label: Build id
inputs.about: the orchestrator build (or branch) this run works on

inputs.label: What to build
inputs.default: the next open step of the build in the orchestrator

data.brief:
Build {{build}}: {{task}}.
1. Read _claude/THREADS.md and the build's record (orchestrator.mjs next {{build}}); work only on its open steps.
2. Branch claude/{{build}} from origin/main; small commits, clean messages.
3. Run the build's checks and the conformance checks (check-theme, check-controls) for anything visible.
4. Tick each finished step through the orchestrator (act step), push the branch, open the PR and link it (builds-live.mjs link).
Report what changed, the checks, the PR, and what is left.
